subject.title: [Bug] Slack replies still silently dropped on 2026.6.11 — final in transcript, no message_sent, nothing posted (re: #80715)

question: Should this issue own only the reproducible Slack queue/dispatch regression, with generic delivery receipts and terminal outcome semantics remaining in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: The observed message loss is an established bug, but the report also requests a broader cross-channel delivery contract whose API and recovery semantics already have separate maintainer-owned design work.

options.title: Split regression and contract
options.body: Fix the exact Slack session-lane loss here and keep generic delivery receipts, retries, and terminal statuses in the existing cross-channel issue.

options.title: Unify under the contract issue
options.body: Move all implementation work to the cross-channel contract issue, preserving this report only as a Slack proving case.

options.title: Broaden this issue
options.body: Use this issue for both the Slack race and the durable cross-channel contract, accepting a substantially larger implementation and validation scope.

recommendation.title: Split regression and contract
recommendation.body: Fix the exact Slack session-lane loss here and keep generic delivery receipts, retries, and terminal statuses in the existing cross-channel issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior final-reply ownership repair was merged through this owner, and the decision spans core reply lifecycle and channel-delivery boundaries.
